words.native_definition: a shape, outline, or form that can be recognized; a number or amount; a person of a particular kind
words.core_concept: a recognizable form – 一个可被辨认的形态
words.core_image: 远处看到一个人的轮廓，能认出身形；数字是代表数量的符号形状
examples: I saw a figure standing in the dark.
Sales figures increased by 10% this quarter.
He is an important public figure.
semantic_expansions: figure out：把模糊的信息整理成清晰的轮廓 → 弄明白
words.root_logic: figur（形状）→ 一个可辨认的形态 → 身影/数字/人物

words.origin: 拉丁语 configurare：con-（一起）+ figura（形状）
words.native_definition: to arrange parts into a particular structure or form
words.core_concept: arranging components into a desired form – 把零件组合成目标结构
words.core_image: 工程师把散落的电路模块按目标排列组合成一台整机
examples: Please configure the network settings before starting.
The software can be configured to run in different modes.
words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ figur（形状）→ 把零件组合成目标形状 → 配置

words.origin: 拉丁语 figura + -ative（与形状/形象相关的）
words.native_definition: using words in a way that departs from their literal meaning; based on figures or symbols
words.core_concept: turning an image into a meaning – 把形象转化为比喻含义
words.core_image: 一个具体的形象（figure）被借去表达抽象的意思，如用'山的腿'表达山脚
examples: 'He has a heart of stone' is a figurative expression.
words.root_logic: figur（形象）+ -ative（…的）→ 借形象表达 → 比喻的

words.native_definition: to spoil the appearance or shape of something
words.core_concept: destroying the recognizable form – 毁掉可辨认的形态
words.core_image: 一张清晰的脸被划伤，轮廓被破坏，认不出来了
examples: The building was disfigured by graffiti.
words.root_logic: dis-（去除）+ figur（形状）→ 毁掉形状 → 损毁外形

words.native_definition: the way in which parts are arranged to form a whole
words.core_concept: the resulting arrangement of parts – 零件组合后的整体形态
words.core_image: 乐高拼好后的最终成品造型
examples: The configuration of the new system takes time.
words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ figur（形状）+ -ation（名词）→ 组合后的形态 → 配置/结构

words.native_definition: the force or weight that pushes against something; the stress of a difficult situation
words.core_concept: force pushing down or against – 施加下来的力
words.core_image: 上面的重量持续往下压，压得喘不过气
examples: The pressure of work is increasing.
Blood pressure should be checked regularly.
semantic_expansions: 心理压力 = 无形的力压在心上
words.root_logic: press（压）+ -ure（名词）→ 压下来的力 → 压力

words.native_definition: to press something firmly into a surface; to make someone feel admiration or respect
words.core_concept: pressing an image into someone's mind – 把印象压进心里
words.core_image: 印章把图案压进纸里；一件事深深印在脑海里
examples: Her performance impressed the judges.
The view impressed itself on my memory.
semantic_expansions: im- 往里压 → 把记号压进心里 → 留下深刻印象
words.root_logic: im-（往里）+ press（压）→ 把印记压进心里 → 印象深刻

words.native_definition: to press out; to show or say what you think or feel
words.core_concept: pressing thoughts outward – 把心里的想法压出来
words.core_image: 内心的话像被挤压的牙膏一样从出口流出来
examples: She expressed her gratitude in a letter.
Words cannot express how I feel.
semantic_expansions: ex- 向外压 → 把感情'压'出来 → 表达
快递 express = 快速'送出'（送=向外压出）
words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ press（压）→ 把内心的话压出来 → 表达

words.native_definition: to press down and stop something from happening, spreading, or being seen
words.core_concept: pressing something down so it cannot rise – 压下去不让它冒出来
words.core_image: 用手把要冒出来的气泡压回水面下
examples: He suppressed a laugh.
The government suppressed the protest.
words.root_logic: sup-（在下）+ press（压）→ 压下去不让冒出来 → 压制/抑制

words.native_definition: to press things together into a smaller space
words.core_concept: pressing together into less space – 把散的东西压到一起变小
words.core_image: 把一堆棉花压成一个小方块
examples: The file was compressed to save space.
semantic_expansions: com- 一起压 → 压在一起 → 压缩
words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ press（压）→ 压到一起 → 压缩

words.origin: 拉丁语 formalis（与形式有关的）
words.native_definition: following an official or established form; serious and proper
words.core_concept: having a set form – 有固定形式/规格的
words.core_image: 宴会厅里按规矩摆放的整齐餐具，一切都有固定形态
examples: You need formal approval to proceed.
words.root_logic: form（形状）+ -al（…的）→ 有固定形式的 → 正式的

words.native_definition: to give someone knowledge that shapes their understanding
words.core_concept: putting knowledge into shape – 把信息塞进对方心里形成认知
words.core_image: 把一条信息'放进'对方的头脑，对方的认知随之成形
examples: Please inform us of any changes.
semantic_expansions: in- 进入 + form 成形 → 让信息在脑子里成形 → 告知
words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ form（成形）→ 让信息在脑中成形 → 告知

words.native_definition: to change completely from one form to another
words.core_concept: moving across from one shape to another – 从一个形态跨到另一个形态
words.core_image: 毛毛虫跨越形态变成蝴蝶
examples: The city has been transformed in ten years.
semantic_expansions: trans- 跨越 + form 形态 → 跨越形态边界 → 彻底改变
words.root_logic: trans-（跨越）+ form（形状）→ 跨越形态界限 → 转变

words.native_definition: to carry out completely; to give a performance
words.core_concept: bringing something fully into form – 把一件事完整地做成形
words.core_image: 舞台上演员把整个节目完整地呈现出来
examples: The doctor performed the surgery successfully.
She performed beautifully on stage.
semantic_expansions: per- 完全 + form 成形 → 完整地做成形 → 执行/表演
words.root_logic: per-（完全）+ form（成形）→ 完整做成形 → 执行/表演

words.native_definition: to form or shape again; to improve by making changes
words.core_concept: reshaping into a better form – 重新塑造成更好的形态
words.core_image: 把变形的东西重新捏回规整的样子
examples: The government promised to reform the education system.
semantic_expansions: re- 重新 + form 成形 → 重新成形 → 改革
words.root_logic: re-（重新）+ form（成形）→ 重新成形 → 改革

words.native_definition: to pull something toward yourself; to make someone interested
words.core_concept: pulling toward – 朝自己方向拉
words.core_image: 磁铁把铁屑朝自己拉过来；目光被吸引过去
examples: The new shop attracts many customers.
semantic_expansions: at- 朝向 + tract 拉 → 把对方朝自己拉 → 吸引
words.root_logic: at-（朝向）+ tract（拉）→ 朝自己拉 → 吸引

words.native_definition: to pull something out, especially with effort
words.core_concept: pulling out – 用力往外拉出来
words.core_image: 用镊子把嵌在肉里的刺拔出来
examples: The dentist extracted the tooth.
Oil is extracted from these seeds.
semantic_expansions: ex- 向外 + tract 拉 → 往外拉 → 提取
words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ tract（拉）→ 往外拉出 → 提取

words.native_definition: to pull together; a written agreement binding parties together
words.core_concept: pulling together – 拉到一起 / 让双方绑在一起的约定
words.core_image: 两人握手把关系拉在一起，签下把双方绑定的文书
examples: Metal contracts when it cools.
They signed a contract for the project.
semantic_expansions: con- 一起拉 → 拉在一起 → 合同（把双方拉到一起）/ 收缩（拉到一起变小）
words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ tract（拉）→ 拉到一起 → 合同/收缩

words.native_definition: to pull someone's attention away from something
words.core_concept: pulling attention apart – 把注意力拉开
words.core_image: 一条线把目光从书本上拉向窗外
examples: The noise distracted me from my work.
semantic_expansions: dis- 分开 + tract 拉 → 把注意力拉走 → 分心
words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ tract（拉）→ 把注意力拉开 → 分心

words.native_definition: a powerful vehicle that pulls farm machinery
words.core_concept: a thing that pulls – 用来拉拽的机器
words.core_image: 田野里轰鸣的机器拖着犁前进
examples: The farmer drove the tractor across the field.
semantic_expansions: -or 表示'东西' → 拉东西的机器 → 拖拉机
words.root_logic: tract（拉）+ -or（东西）→ 拉东西的机器 → 拖拉机

words.native_definition: the place where something is put; a job; a point of view
words.core_concept: where something is placed – 被放置的位置
words.core_image: 棋子被摆放在棋盘上的某个格子里
examples: Please find the position marked on the map.
She applied for a manager position.
semantic_expansions: 放置的位置 → 职位（人在组织中的位置）/ 立场（观点所处的位置）
words.root_logic: pos（放置）+ -ition（名词）→ 被放置之处 → 位置/职位

words.native_definition: to put parts together to form a whole; to write music or a text
words.core_concept: placing parts together – 把各部分放到一起
words.core_image: 把音符一个个摆放到五线谱上组成乐曲
examples: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.
He composed a beautiful symphony.
semantic_expansions: com- 一起放置 → 把部分放到一起 → 组成 / 创作
words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pose（放置）→ 把部分放到一起 → 组成/创作

words.native_definition: to place something out in the open so it can be seen
words.core_concept: placing out into the open – 放置到外面让人看见
words.core_image: 把藏在幕布后的东西搬到阳光下展示出来
examples: The report exposed the scandal.
Don't expose your skin to the sun too long.
semantic_expansions: ex- 向外放置 → 放到外面 → 暴露/揭露
words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ pose（放置）→ 放到外面 → 暴露/揭露

words.native_definition: to put an idea forward for consideration
words.core_concept: placing an idea forward – 把想法放到前面
words.core_image: 把方案放在桌上推到对方面前
examples: I propose we start early tomorrow.
He proposed to her on the beach.
semantic_expansions: pro- 向前放置 → 把建议放到前面 → 提议（求婚=把心意放往前）
words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ pose（放置）→ 把想法放到前面 → 提议

words.native_definition: to place yourself against something
words.core_concept: placing against – 放到对立面
words.core_image: 两军面对面摆开阵势，立场相对
examples: Many residents oppose the new plan.
semantic_expansions: ob- 对着放置 → 放到对面 → 反对
words.root_logic: op-（对着）+ pose（放置）→ 放到对立面 → 反对

words.native_definition: to send someone in; to accept that something is true
words.core_concept: sending toward / letting in – 往里面送，放进来
words.core_image: 门口的人放行让客人进入；把'这是真的'放进心里承认
examples: He admitted his mistake.
She was admitted to the university.
semantic_expansions: ad- 朝向送 → 送进 → 准入/承认
words.root_logic: ad-（朝向）+ mit（送）→ 送进来 → 承认/准入

words.native_definition: to send yourself fully to something; to do something (often wrong)
words.core_concept: sending yourself entirely – 把自己整个交出去
words.core_image: 把全部的心力'送'给一件事，再也没有退路
examples: She committed herself to the project.
He committed a serious crime.
semantic_expansions: com- 完全送 → 把自己完全送出去 → 承诺/投入（犯事=把行为完全'送'出去）
words.root_logic: com-（完全）+ mit（送）→ 把自己完全送出去 → 承诺/投入

words.native_definition: to let something pass; to allow
words.core_concept: sending through – 放行通过
words.core_image: 门卫挥手让车辆通过关卡
examples: Smoking is not permitted here.
You need a permit to park here.
semantic_expansions: per- 通过 + mit 送 → 放行送过去 → 允许
words.root_logic: per-（通过）+ mit（送）→ 放行送过去 → 允许

words.native_definition: to send something across from one place or person to another
words.core_concept: sending across – 跨越距离送过去
words.core_image: 信号塔把电波跨越大山送到远方
examples: The disease is transmitted through water.
Data is transmitted over the network.
semantic_expansions: trans- 跨越送 → 送过距离 → 传输
words.root_logic: trans-（跨越）+ mit（送）→ 送过距离 → 传输

words.origin: 拉丁语 missio（送出的任务）
words.native_definition: a task that someone is sent to do; a group sent on a mission
words.core_concept: something sent out to be accomplished – 被派出去完成的任务
words.core_image: 一队人被派往远方执行指定任务
examples: The team completed its mission successfully.
semantic_expansions: -sion 名词后缀 → 被'送出去'的事 → 使命/任务
words.root_logic: miss（送）+ -ion（名词）→ 被送出去的任务 → 使命

words.native_definition: to look at something carefully and closely
words.core_concept: looking into details – 往里面仔细看
words.core_image: 质检员把产品拿近，仔细查看每个细节
examples: Officials inspected the factory for safety.
semantic_expansions: in- 往里看 → 仔细看内部 → 检查
words.root_logic: in-（往里）+ spect（看）→ 往里仔细看 → 检查

words.native_definition: to look back at someone with high regard; admiration
words.core_concept: looking back with regard – 回望并给予重视
words.core_image: 面对值得敬重的人，目光里充满敬意地注视
examples: I respect her for her honesty.
In this respect, we agree.
semantic_expansions: re- 反复看 → 因反复注视而产生敬意 → 尊重
words.root_logic: re-（反复）+ spect（看）→ 反复注视 → 尊敬

words.native_definition: the possibility of what lies ahead; a view into the future
words.core_concept: looking forward – 向前看
words.core_image: 站在山顶向前眺望，看到远处的可能性
examples: The prospects for growth are good.
semantic_expansions: pro- 向前看 → 向前看的景象 → 前景
words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ spect（看）→ 向前看的景象 → 前景

words.native_definition: a person who watches an event
words.core_concept: one who looks – 观看的人
words.core_image: 看台上鼓掌呐喊的观众
examples: Thousands of spectators watched the match.
semantic_expansions: -ator 表'人' → 看的人 → 观众
words.root_logic: spect（看）+ -ator（人）→ 看的人 → 观众

words.native_definition: to look forward to something happening
words.core_concept: looking outward toward what will come – 向外看向将要到来的事
words.core_image: 站在门口向外张望，等待某人到来
examples: We expect the results tomorrow.
semantic_expansions: ex- 向外看 → 向外看向未来 → 期待
words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ spect（看）→ 向外看向未来 → 期待

words.native_definition: to write or say what something is like
words.core_concept: writing something down fully – 把所见完全写下来
words.core_image: 把看到的画面一笔一笔写下来让别人也能看见
examples: Can you describe the man you saw?
semantic_expansions: de- 完全 + scrib 写 → 完整地写下来 → 描述
words.root_logic: de-（完全）+ scrib（写）→ 完整写下来 → 描述

words.native_definition: to write out a rule or a medical treatment in advance
words.core_concept: writing rules beforehand – 预先写下的规定
words.core_image: 医生在处方笺上预先写好用药方法
examples: The doctor prescribed antibiotics.
semantic_expansions: pre- 预先写 → 预先写下的要求 → 处方/规定
words.root_logic: pre-（预先）+ scrib（写）→ 预先写下的规定 → 处方/规定

words.native_definition: a written copy of what was said or recorded
words.core_concept: writing carried across – 把说过的话抄写转移过来
words.core_image: 把录音里的对话一字一字抄到纸上
examples: The court transcript was released.
She ordered her college transcript.
semantic_expansions: trans- 跨越 + script 写下的 → 从原声跨越到纸面 → 记录/抄本
words.root_logic: trans-（跨越）+ script（写下的）→ 从原声抄写过来 → 记录/抄本

words.native_definition: a book or document written by hand or typed before printing
words.core_concept: written by hand – 手写出来的东西
words.core_image: 中世纪僧侣伏案手抄经文的羊皮卷
examples: The author sent her manuscript to the publisher.
semantic_expansions: manu- 手 + script 写 → 手写的 → 手稿
words.root_logic: manu-（手）+ script（写下的）→ 手写的 → 手稿

words.native_definition: to write your name at the bottom to agree or sign up
words.core_concept: writing your name underneath – 在下方签名表示同意
words.core_image: 在合同的底端签下自己的名字表示订阅/同意
examples: I subscribed to the channel.
He subscribed to the agreement.
semantic_expansions: sub- 在下面写 → 在文件下方签名 → 订阅/赞同
words.root_logic: sub-（在下面）+ scrib（写）→ 在下方签名 → 订阅/赞同

words.native_definition: to guide or lead; to carry out an activity
words.core_concept: leading together along a path – 带领着一起走
words.core_image: 指挥家挥动指挥棒带领整个乐团往前走
examples: The experiment was conducted carefully.
He conducts the school orchestra.
semantic_expansions: con- 一起引导 → 引导整个流程 → 进行/指挥
words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ duct（引导）→ 带领整个流程 → 进行/指挥

words.native_definition: to bring something forward into existence
words.core_concept: leading forward into existence – 把事物引导出来
words.core_image: 工厂流水线把原料一步步引导成成品
examples: The factory produces cars.
The plan produced great results.
semantic_expansions: pro- 向前引导 → 引导出来 → 生产
words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ duct（引导）→ 引导出来 → 生产

words.native_definition: to lead someone in; to make something known for the first time
words.core_concept: leading in – 把新事物引导进来
words.core_image: 主人把客人引荐到屋内，介绍给大家认识
examples: Let me introduce my colleague.
The city introduced a new transport system.
semantic_expansions: intro- 向内引导 → 引进来 → 介绍/引进
words.root_logic: intro-（向内）+ duct（引导）→ 引导进来 → 介绍/引进

words.native_definition: to lead someone out of ignorance into knowledge
words.core_concept: leading out – 把学习者从无知中引导出来
words.core_image: 老师像向导一样带着学生走出黑暗的房间，走进光明
examples: Schools educate children for the future.
semantic_expansions: e- 向外引导 → 引导出来（走出无知）→ 教育
words.root_logic: e-（向外）+ duc（引导）→ 带出无知 → 教育

words.native_definition: to lead something back to a smaller state
words.core_concept: leading back / down – 引导回更小的状态
words.core_image: 把水位引导回去，让水面降下来
examples: We must reduce our expenses.
semantic_expansions: re- 往回引导 → 引导回去变小 → 减少
words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ duct（引导）→ 引导回更小 → 减少

words.native_definition: to carry goods into a country from abroad
words.core_concept: carrying in – 从外面运进来
words.core_image: 货轮把集装箱从国外运进港口
examples: The country imports most of its oil.
semantic_expansions: im- 向内运 → 运进来 → 进口
words.root_logic: im-（向内）+ port（运送）→ 运进来 → 进口

words.native_definition: to carry goods out of a country for sale abroad
words.core_concept: carrying out – 运出去
words.core_image: 满载货物的轮船驶离港口开往国外
examples: They export rice to many countries.
semantic_expansions: ex- 向外运 → 运出去 → 出口
words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ port（运送）→ 运出去 → 出口

words.native_definition: to carry people or goods across a distance
words.core_concept: carrying across – 跨越距离运送
words.core_image: 卡车把货物从城市这头运到那头
examples: The goods were transported by rail.
semantic_expansions: trans- 跨越运 → 运过距离 → 运输
words.root_logic: trans-（跨越）+ port（运送）→ 运过距离 → 运输

words.native_definition: able to be carried easily
words.core_concept: carriable – 能被带走的
words.core_image: 一个能轻松装进背包带走的设备
examples: This is a portable speaker.
semantic_expansions: port 运 + -able 能 → 能运的 → 便携的
words.root_logic: port（运送）+ -able（能…的）→ 能带走的 → 便携的

words.native_definition: to carry information back to someone
words.core_concept: carrying information back – 把信息带回去
words.core_image: 信使把前线的消息带回指挥部
examples: The journalist reported on the event.
Please report any problems to us.
semantic_expansions: re- 往回运 → 把消息运回去 → 报告
words.root_logic: re-（返回）+ port（运送）→ 把消息带回去 → 报告
